summary: The candidate substantially implements skip_cache_insert and passed focused unit tests plus live MI350X radix/HiCache tests, but it violates the original issue's explicit backward-compatibility contract. Req previously derived skip_radix_cache_insert from bootstrap_host == FAKE_BOOTSTRAP_HOST; the candidate derives it only from skip_cache_insert and includes a test requiring the legacy sentinel not to skip. Existing clients using bootstrap_host: 2.2.2.2 therefore begin inserting request KV unless changed in lockstep.

tests.what_was_measured: On the actual prepared base, GenerateReqInput has no skip_cache_insert parameter, construction with it raises TypeError, and OpenAI chat/completion/responses models discard the unknown field. Raw output: /job/review-evidence-j-dff2bedd469e/base-reproduction.txt.

Confirmed imports resolve to /job/repo/python/sglang, all requested public models expose the field, and single/batched GenerateReqInput normalization preserves true/false values. Raw output: /job/review-evidence-j-dff2bedd469e/candidate-imports.txt.

241 tests and 81 subtests passed, covering request propagation, cache backends, chunked-prefill ownership, OpenAI adapters, and internal synthetic callers. Raw output: /job/review-evidence-j-dff2bedd469e/candidate-focused-unit.txt.

The candidate explicitly tests and enforces the incompatible behavior: FAKE_BOOTSTRAP_HOST alone no longer skips insertion. Base source sets skip_radix_cache_insert from that sentinel; candidate source sets it only from skip_cache_insert. Raw output: /job/review-evidence-j-dff2bedd469e/candidate-sentinel-regression.txt.

Five live tests passed on both plain radix and HiCache write_through with Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct: explicit opt-out left no reusable prefix, normal requests inserted, opted-out requests read existing prefixes, per-item batches worked, OpenAI chat worked, and a 64-token chunk size exercised multi-chunk prompts. Raw output: /job/review-evidence-j-dff2bedd469e/candidate-e2e-gpu.txt.

gpu_execution.evidence: Assigned GPU 0 was an AMD Instinct MI350X (gfx950, unique ID 0x5e94f9cc641f4027). Live inference ran through ROCm 7.2/PyTorch 2.11.0+rocm7.2. Inventory: /job/review-evidence-j-dff2bedd469e/gpu-inventory.txt.

remaining_counterexamples: A request that relied on the existing bootstrap_host value 2.2.2.2 without the new field skipped radix/HiCache insertion on the base but inserts under the candidate. This contradicts the issue requirement that the PD sentinel keep working unchanged.
remaining_limitations: No native C++/FlyDSL source changed, so no native rebuild was applicable; radix_cache_cpp.py is Python and its focused tests passed. Prefill-only PD, speculative decoding, retraction, pure-SWA on live GPU, and the repository-default gated Llama model were not exercised end to end. The live matrix used public Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct. Aiter compiled gfx950 kernels during startup and warned that the pinned clang does not accept -amdgpu-coerce-illegal-types=1, then retried without it; inference and all E2E assertions completed.
